description: Wire three built-in issue templates (Feature/Bug/Refactor) as file assets with two-stage on-demand loading, trim template metadata to name + description, remove programmatic template matching, and supersede mohist/default with a feature alias; update CLI and Web consumers in lockstep.

tasks.title: Server: file-asset template loading model with trimmed metadata
tasks.description: Replace the hardcoded MohistDefaultIssueTemplate with a file-asset loader that discovers the three built-ins from templates/*.md using PromptFrontmatterParser, with two-stage loading (List parses frontmatter only, Get parses frontmatter + body into IssueTemplateSection). Rework IssueTemplateRegistry so built-ins come from files, trim IIssueTemplate/IssueTemplateInfo/IssueTemplateDetail metadata to name + description (drop about/suitableFor/defaults/isDefault), remove the template-side registry.Matches() path (keep SuitableForMatcher for workflow profiles), make feature the canonical id with a mohist/default compat alias, relax custom-template ValidateTemplate to tolerant deserialization mapping About→description, gate all three built-ins behind DisableDefaultIssueTemplate, and add the csproj PreserveNewest content include for templates/*.md.
acceptanceCriteria: MohistDefaultIssueTemplate.cs is deleted; no built-in template content originates from a hardcoded C# class.
IssueTemplateRegistry loads the Feature, Bug, and Refactor built-ins from templates/*.md at runtime.
List()/GET /api/issue-templates parse frontmatter only and return metadata entries exposing exactly name + description (no about/suitableFor/defaults/isDefault).
Get()/GET /api/issue-templates/:id parse frontmatter and body and return name + description + parsed sections.
IssueTemplateInfo is (Id, Name, Description, Source) and IssueTemplateDetail is (Id, Name, Description, Sections, Source).
registry.Matches() is removed from the template path; IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry still invokes SuitableForMatcher.Matches() unchanged.

GET /api/issue-templates/feature returns the Feature template; GET /api/issue-templates/mohist/default returns an identical response via the alias; IssueTemplates.DefaultId source of truth is "feature".
Custom-template deserialization requires only Id + Name + Sections and maps legacy About to description; existing custom rows surface without error.
DisableDefaultIssueTemplate gates all three built-ins (project sees only its custom templates when set).
Server csproj includes templates/*.md with CopyToOutputDirectory=PreserveNewest and they are present in build output.
IssueTemplateRegistrySpecs cover file loading, frontmatter-only list, body-on get, alias resolution, tolerant custom deserialization, and DisableDefault gating.
IssueTemplateApiSpecs assert the trimmed list and detail response shapes and the feature/mohist-default alias equivalence.
Body-parser specs read the actual templates/*.md and assert each section's title/guidance/placeholder.
`dotnet build Mohist.sln` passes with TreatWarningsAsErrors (server-side consumers compile against the new shape).
tasks.output: packages/server issue-template loader, reworked IssueTemplateRegistry, trimmed IIssueTemplate/IssueTemplateInfo/IssueTemplateDetail records and Api/IssueTemplateRoutes, deleted MohistDefaultIssueTemplate.cs, feature alias, tolerant custom deserialization, csproj content include, plus IssueTemplateRegistrySpecs/IssueTemplateApiSpecs/body-parser specs
tasks.notes: Design decisions D1–D8 apply. This is one functional module (the template registry/loading model); the metadata trim, loader, alias, tolerant deserialization, Matches() removal, and hardcoded-class deletion are tightly coupled by TreatWarningsAsErrors and must ship together. SuitableForMatcher class itself stays (used by workflow profiles); only the template call site is removed.

tasks.title: CLI: render trimmed template metadata and feature alias
tasks.description: Update the CLI template commands to consume the trimmed name + description metadata: TableRenderer.IssueTemplates.cs list rendering shows only name + description (no body sections, no suitableFor/about), get rendering renders the full sections, and command help text referencing mohist/default is updated to feature.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo issue template list` output shows each template's name and description and does not include body sections or the removed metadata fields.
`mo issue template get feature` renders the Feature template's full sections.
`mo issue template get mohist/default` resolves via the alias and renders identically to `feature`.
CLI help text examples reference `feature` rather than `mohist/default`.
CliIssueTemplateCommandSpecs assert list shows name + description, get returns sections, and feature/mohist-default both resolve.
`dotnet build Mohist.sln` passes with TreatWarningsAsErrors (CLI compiles against the new response shape).
tasks.output: Updated packages/cli TableRenderer.IssueTemplates.cs, command help text, and CliIssueTemplateCommandSpecs
tasks.notes: Consumes the HTTP response shape finalized in T-001. CLI is .NET and shares Mohist.sln with the server, so it must move in lockstep with the server metadata change.

tasks.title: Web: align issue-template consumers to trimmed metadata
tasks.description: Update Web consumers of the issue-template list/detail response to the trimmed name + description shape: align the TypeScript types, CreateIssueDialog.tsx, and any client/queries that reference the old fields, so the create-issue dialog compiles and renders against the new response shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Web TypeScript types for issue-template list/detail entries expose only name + description (+ sections on detail) and no longer reference about/suitableFor/defaults/isDefault.
CreateIssueDialog.tsx and any other template consumers compile against the trimmed shape with no dangling references to removed fields.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web` passes.
`npm run test:run -w packages/web` passes (client/queries and dialog tests updated for the new shape).
tasks.output: Updated packages/web issue-template types, CreateIssueDialog.tsx, and related client/queries tests
tasks.notes: Scope is the lockstep metadata trim only. Surfacing description in the create-issue dropdown is explicitly deferred (Non-Goal). Independent of T-002 (different package, different test suite); both consume the server shape from T-001.
